"''This is the best I could do. It's an Emergency Work Order for the Eight Hundred Block. Three sweepers that need fixing.|Kellen and Brasso|}} '''Eight Hundred Block''' was a location on the agricultural world [[Mina-Rau]]. By [[4 BBY]],{{AndorDate|203}} [[Kellen]] gave [[Brasso]] an adulterated [[Emergency Work Order]] for the Eight Hundred Block so Brasso, [[Bix Caleen]] and [[Wilmon Paak]] could hide from the [[Galactic Empire]], as they did not possess [[visa]]s and were thus undocumented workers on Mina-Rau. ==Behind the scenes== Eight Hundred Block was mentioned during the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Harvest}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ბლოკი რვაასი }} [[Category:Mina-Rau locations]]
